description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notify the Order to revise existing the license fee for bottling toddy. w.e.f. 01.04.2018
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to the amendment of an existing notification under the Excise Ordinance, specifically revising license fees for bottling Toddy. It involves regulatory changes to existing legislation (Excise Ordinance) and falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure, land, commercial, elections, public service, judicial, or miscellaneous categories.
